title: Delivery stalled
description: My parcel has been sitting at the same sorting center. Please investigate the delivery problem.

description: I have moved. Please contact the courier to redirect this order to my new address.

description: I am not requesting a return or a refund. I only want to know when it will be delivered.

description: A friend suggested a refund, but I do not want that. Please first check why my parcel is marked as delivered.

description: I am not asking for a refund or a return. I need to find out why the payment failed.

label: payment

label: payment

label: payment

title: Exchange the size
description: The shoes I received are too small. Please exchange them for a larger size.

description: I no longer need this item. I want to cancel the purchase and get my money back.

description: There is no need to chase delivery anymore. I want a refund now.

label: returns

label: returns

title: Do not want to keep the item
description: I want to send this item back to the seller and get my money back. I do not need parcel tracking.
label: returns

title: Forgotten password

title: Login verification code
description: The login verification code never arrives, so I cannot access my account.

label: account

title: Restore account access
description: The return process is finished. I now only need the login restriction removed from my account.

title: Login on a new phone

label: account

title: Cannot access my profile
description: I want to view orders in my profile, but the system keeps signing me out. Please fix my account access.
label: account

title: Problems with two orders

title: Two independent problems
description: I need help because I cannot log in to my account. Separately, please check the duplicate charge on another order.
label: human

description: Something about this order looks wrong, but I do not know what it is.
label: human

title: Missing details
description: Please deal with the matter I mentioned yesterday.
label: human

title: Human help with payment
description: The payment failed again. This time I want a human support agent to handle it directly.
label: human

description: I do not want to continue automated account recovery. Please transfer me to a real person.
label: human
